result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides, controlled by overhead traffic signals. However, dedicated pedestrian signal heads are not visible, and the wide street width increases exposure time for those crossing.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection corners where signals would typically be mounted.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the one-way street increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve predictability and safety for crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and reduce vehicle turning speeds.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks, but the wide roadway creates a long unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians. While the intersection is signalized for vehicles, dedicated pedestrian signal heads are not clearly visible from this perspective.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway exposes pedestrians to traffic for an extended period without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalk.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears to allow for relatively high-speed vehicle turns across the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide two-lane urban street with a marked continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and markings are present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming or signals increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide roadway without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No visible stop signs or traffic signals to regulate vehicle flow at the pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide two-way roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk and a bus shelter. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a median refuge island increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a mid-point refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the left side may block the sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway near the crosswalk and bus stop

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the crosswalk to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.
